items.description: A major city monument in central Gaborone. It honors the three dikgosi and is one of the capital's best-known landmarks.
The regional headquarters of the Southern African Development Community in Gaborone. It is a key diplomatic landmark.
A modern high-rise complex shaping Gaborone's skyline. It combines offices, retail, and city-centre presence.
A major bridge over the Zambezi linking Botswana and Zambia. It is a key transport landmark in southern Africa.
The main stadium in Francistown and one of Botswana's largest sports venues. It hosts football and major events.
The National Assembly building in Gaborone is the seat of Botswana's parliament. It is a central political landmark.
A technology and start-up hub in Gaborone. It supports innovation, research, and new business growth.
A prominent cathedral in Gaborone. It is one of the city's best-known religious buildings.
A notable office building connected to Botswana's diamond industry. It is part of Gaborone's corporate landscape.
Gaborone International Convention Centre is a major venue for conferences and events. It plays a visible role in the capital's business life.
The High Court building in Lobatse is an important judicial landmark. It reflects the town's legal and administrative role.
The national museum in Gaborone is a major cultural landmark. It showcases Botswana's history and heritage.
